basics.name: Mohammad Ali Safaei
basics.label: Researcher
basics.summary: A researcher with a strong academic background in Nonlinear Solid Mechanics and Finite Element Analysis (FEA), with research experience in dielectric elastomer actuators, metamaterials with TPMS geometries, and constitutive modelling. Assistant reviewer for over 50 journal submissions.

work.name: Faradars, Tehran, Iran
work.summary: Delivering online courses on smart materials and constitutive modelling.

work.name: Nogolearn Institute, Tehran, Iran
work.summary: Teaching and mentoring Advanced and Upper-intermediate English learners preparing for the IELTS exam.

work.name: Emamat High School, Tehran, Iran
work.summary: Teaching English to 8th grade high school students.

work.name: Smart Materials & Structures (SMS) Laboratory, University of Tehran
work.summary: Authored Section 1.3 of the book "Computational Modeling of Intelligent Soft Matter". Worked on Dielectric Elastomer Actuators (DEAs), Stimuli-Responsive Hydrogels, and Shape Memory Polymers (SMPs).

work.name: College of Engineering, University of Tehran
work.summary: Assisted in courses on Finite Element Analysis (FEA), Non-linear Solid Mechanics, and Research Methodology.

volunteer.summary: Reviewed over 50 submissions for journals such as Chemical Engineering Journal, Additive Manufacturing, Advanced Engineering Materials, and Polymers.
